title: Only owners and admins manage public groups, admins can't edit personal ones
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Tag groups tab.
  • An active location is selected.
  • A public group; a personal group owned by another user; sign-in as a non-owner non-admin, and as an admin.
custom_steps:
1. As a non-owner non-admin, look for Edit/Delete on a public group.
  2. As an admin, try to edit or delete another user's personal group.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A user who is neither the owner nor an admin sees no Edit or Delete on a public group.
  • An admin cannot edit or delete another user's personal group.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-N5: “A user who is neither the owner nor an admin sees no Edit or Delete on a public group.”
  • S6-N6: “An admin cannot edit or delete another user's personal group.”
